title: 2006 HMMT February Team Round 2 Problem 4
statement: For \(n=m=4\), find a formation with 6 mobots for which there are exactly 12 ways to color the mobots in three colors as in problem 3. (No proof is necessary.)

solutions.text: Place north-oriented mobots at \((0,0),(1,0),(2,2)\), and \((3,2)\), and eastoriented mobots at \((2,0)\) and \((2,1)\). Other formations are possible.
